title: Berlin Art Week 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin Art Week runs from 9 to 13 September 2026.** It brings exhibitions, performances, film screenings and talks to venues across Berlin.
**Choose one district per day.** Kulturforum suits a focused cultural afternoon, Tempelhof suits the Positions fair day, and Mitte works when you want art plus the historic centre.
The programme changes by day: Wednesday openings, Thursday fair and gallery events, Friday independent spaces, Saturday Open Houses and limited collection visits, and Sunday talks and tours.
Saturday has two planning styles: reserve a limited collection visit first, or choose the no-registration Open Houses route and keep the day loose.
Check the official programme and locations before leaving your hotel. Individual times, access and registration can change.
